entryLinks.name: Legion Land Raider Proteus Carrier Squadron

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Weapons that target this model do not benefit from any **Anti-x** abilities the weapon may have.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of your turn pick one of these abilities. These are given to all **Alpha Legion** units till the start of your next turn:
- Burst of Speed: add 2" to advance and charge rolls
- Prefered Prey: Re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1
- Sudden Strike: If no enermy unit in combat has **Fights First** this unit is treated as having it

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the game before any deployments are made you can select up to 3 **Alpha Legion** units. Give all 3 and **Alpharius** one of these abilities however all of them must have the same one:
- **Infiltrators**
- **Scouts 6"**
- **Deep Strike**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model must be your warlord and while withing 3" of a friendly **Alpha Legion Infantry** model this model gains **Lone Operative**.


At the end of the deployment phase you can select up to 3 models and re-deploy them however you want including putting them in reserves. This does not effect the pts in reserves and does not count towards the limit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this model makes an attack in the fight phase any **Hit rolls** of 4+ gain **[Precision]**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When making **melee attacks** **Armillus Dynaty**  can use both **The Prince** and the **The Prophet** but can only make a total of 5 attacks with both weapons but this does not stop an attack from **Thunderstrike**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can pick up to 3 **Alpha Legion Infantry** units at the start of the deployment phase before any deployments are made. Give all 3 of thouse units 1 of these abilities however all 3 must have the same one:
- **Infiltrators**
- **Scout 6"**
- **Conuterattack**: When a unit with this ability has been charged for the rest of the turn they have +1 melee attacks

rules.name: Thunderstrike
rules.description: If a enemy model suffers 1 or more wounds from **The Prince** then **Armillus Dynaty** can make 1 attack with this weapon at the end of the fight

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has a **[Feel No Pain 5+]** against ranged attacks

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This models ranged weapons gain **[Ignores Cover]** and this model ignores all modifers to BS and the to hit roll in addition to any modifiers to range of a weapon.
Finally this can not trigger any **[Feel No Pain]** rolls if it is only activated by **ranged attacks**

characteristics.name: Keywords
characteristics.$text: Precision, Heavy, Anti-Vehicle 4+, Pinning, Deadly Aim

rules.name: Deadly Aim
rules.description: If **Exodus** has not moved this turn improve this weapons damage by 2

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of battle select 1 faction keyword. This unit gains +1 to hit against all models with that faction keyword.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of your turn roll a D6 for each injured model in this unit. If you roll a 5+ for a model it restores 1 wound.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When making **ranged attacks**, any hit roll of a 4+ gains **[Precision]** and if any attacks from this weapon targets a model with the **Charecter** keyword re-roll hit and wound rolls of 1.

sharedRules.name: Lies and Obfuscation
sharedRules.description: Models with this ability counts as being 2" further away for enemy ranged weapons and enemy ranged weapon abilites such as **Melta**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
- **Legion Headhunter Kill Teams** gain the **battleline** keyword
- You gain +2VP if a **Alpha Legion** unit kills the enermy warlord
- During Turn 1 all **Alpha Legion** units gain a **[Feel No Pain 5+]** against ranged attack while more then 12" away from all enermy units.
- All **Vehicles** must be placed in reserves
